info.name: VectorCraft integration
info.summary: Edit SVG and Illustrator files in Nextcloud with VectorCraft
info.description:
Open an SVG, Illustrator (.ai), EPS or VectorCraft file in Files with **Edit in VectorCraft** and work on it right in the browser: the pen and shape tools, Pathfinder, gradients and patterns, type on a path, artboards, symbols and layers.
- **Save** writes the drawing straight back to Nextcloud in its own format, and Nextcloud keeps the previous state as a file version. - **Save As**, **Save a Copy** and **Export** (PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG…) store a file in any folder you pick. - Read-only files open normally; saving offers a copy. - If someone else changes the file while you have it open, you choose whether to replace their version or save a copy. - Optionally, clicking a drawing in Files opens it in VectorCraft.
VectorCraft runs entirely in your browser as WebAssembly. Files go only between your browser and your Nextcloud, and the server needs no extra software.
This is a community integration based on [VectorCraft](https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft) by the ArtCraft team, an open-source, Rust-native vector illustration app. It embeds a build of VectorCraft and is not made or endorsed by the ArtCraft team.
**Requirements:** a browser with WebGPU or WebGL2, and a web server that serves `.wasm` files as `application/wasm` (Nextcloud's own Apache and nginx configurations do).
info.author: Britton Couchman
